case: Same-session enum metadata with repeated search_path changes in a transaction
contract: A transaction changes search_path from enum_shadow_b, enum_shadow_a to enum_shadow_a on the same backend and confirms current_schema after each change.

The schema-aware enum metadata fetched for enum_shadow_b.items remains valid for a keyed update after the transaction changes search_path twice; the target enum remains qualified as enum_shadow_b.status_kind.
The native target and shadow rows retain their expected types and values; the transaction-local session changes are rolled back.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres value_contract_custom_enum_keyed_edit_resolves_shadowed_type_name_by_schema -- --ignored --nocapture

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other PostgreSQL enum session/search_path configurations, deeper domains and custom/native types remain open.
